instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Work out what a buyer would pay for one of my offers and one of its prices: what is due today, what repeats and when, with a trial, a per-unit count, a code or an amount they choose", and give it checkoutAttemptId; checkoutStartedAt; offerId; priceOptionId.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:price-a-sale and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Give offerId, priceOptionId, checkoutAttemptId and checkoutStartedAt, and optionally checkoutCode, unitCount, customerSelectedAmountCents or chargeDimensions.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: record:commercial-offer (records:list); checkout-code-adjustment (records:list).
